Quick answer

For adult rec league, co-ed and pickup teams, MOMUTO makes custom jerseys with your colors, crest, names and numbers, in polyester/elastane with full dye-sublimation, no minimum order. Draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days.

A real jersey for a small-sided team

You don't need a 20-player roster to look the part. An adult rec league, co-ed or pickup team can have a real jersey — crest, sponsor, names and numbers — starting from the free 3D designer or a custom design.

No minimum order, mixed sizes

Order exactly the number of jerseys you need, in any mix of sizes from youth XS to adult 4XL. The per-jersey price still drops with quantity. Size guide.

Turn a pickup group into a team

A shared jersey is what turns a group of friends into a team. Add a sponsor from a local bar or business to cover the cost — see funding your team uniforms.

Frequently asked questions

What's the minimum for an adult rec league team?

There is no minimum. Order from a single jersey up to the whole team; the per-jersey price drops with quantity, down to $25.90/jersey at 10+.

Can everyone pick their own size?

Yes — any mix of sizes from youth XS to adult 4XL in the same order, at no extra cost.

How long before our first match?

Allow 25–30 days from order to delivery, plus a day or two to confirm the design.
